segments.text: A stray kitten found by Makoto, to whom he grows attached. Then, it will be adopted by Minase's family.

His name Piro is originated from the word "Pirozhki"("Пирожки") the Russian national food, that in Russian means "fried buns" or "baked buns" in plural form, but literally translates like "small pies". Yuuichi called the cat as "Piro", because Makoto didn't want to name the cat with food-related terms, but Yuuichi overthought her, that the word Piro has not any sense meaning.
The deceased younger brother of Sayuri.
An old man who sells taiyaki whose Ayu buys from him.
The student council president of the Aizawa Yuuichi's school.
His father and Sayuri's father are acquaintances.
A girl that Yuichi encounters while shopping on the first day he moves to town.
Ayu and Yuichi come to know each other after she bumps into him, literally, during an attempt to eat and run.
The eldest daughter of the Minase family that Yuichi moved in with, she and Yuichi are the same age.
Although she hasn't seen Yuichi in 7 years, she's perfectly fine with him living in the same house.
A girl who has lost her memory.
Going off the only thing she remembers—a disdain for Yuichi—she invites herself into the Minase house and follows him around.
A first-year student at the school Yuichi transfers to.
Her illness kept her out of school for a long time, but after meeting Yuichi, she returns to class.
A third-year student who has forgotten how to smile.
She fights against "something" that cannot be seen in the school building at night.

With his parents having moved overseas for work, he finds himself staying with his aunt who he often visited as a child. For some reason, he doesn't quite remember the details of what happened in this town. Having transfered schools as well, he ends up in the same class as Nayuki.
A first-year student at the school Yuichi transfers to.
She is always alone, and does not allow people to get close to her.
Nayuki's best friend who also becomes one of Yuichi's classmates.
Her personality is the polar opposite of Nayuki's.
A third-year student and Mai's best friend.
She is a friendly girl who is always smiling, in stark contrast to Mai.
The head of the Minase household.
She is Nayuki's mother and Yuichi's aunt.
Yuichi's classmate.
He has a friendly and straightforward personality.
